P0000.rationale: Paragraph (c) explicitly establishes an emergency exception allowing drivers of a CMV to use a hand-held mobile telephone when necessary to communicate with law enforcement or other emergency services. This directly qualifies the general driver prohibition in paragraph (a)(1) (C0000). Adding a structured qualification record with relation 'exception' targeting C0000 faithfully captures this relationship without duplicating baseline duties.
